To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a nonlocal PNJL model with a vector coupling adjusted to lattice QCD data on the slope of the chiral pseudocritical temperature has a critical endpoint, (2) the location of the endpoint depends strongly on the vector coupling and the form factors, and (3) the critical endpoint is robust against changes in the Polyakov-loop potential.
